name: knowledge_transfer_spawn
description: Spawn agent with knowledge filter and confidence cap compiles and runs
input:
event LearnedInsight
  category: Text
  content: Text
  source: Text
  confidence: Number

agent worker
  memory
    topic: Text
  knowledge store: ".forge-knowledge/test-worker"
    max_entries: 100
    retention: 30d

  on start
    say "Worker started for {memory.topic}"
    emit LearnedInsight(category: memory.topic, content: "worker learned something", source: "toolkit", confidence: 0.8)

  if stuck for 2 turns
    escalate to human

exportable agent parent
  knowledge store: ".forge-knowledge/test-parent"
    max_entries: 100
    retention: 30d
  subscribe LearnedInsight where source == "toolkit"

  on start
    learn "FORGE tasks use task keyword" category: "TASKS"
    child = spawn worker as "worker_1"
      with knowledge where category == "TASKS"
      with confidence_cap: 0.8
      with memory topic: "TASKS"
    say "Spawned worker"

  on LearnedInsight(category: Text, content: Text, source: Text, confidence: Number)
    learn "{content}" category: category
    say "Absorbed [{category}]"

fn main
  say "done"
